queuingVerification.des_justification: Off-peak M/M/c gives rho=0.170 (stable), matching simulation's low congestion (<3 min). At peak (13.2 pax/min on one terminal with lognormal 11.5m transit + traffic delay), unrebalanced half-fleet rho=1.478 >= 1.0 causes classical M/M/c queue blow-up and ignores K=50 bulk boarding batching and dynamic deadhead rebalancing, requiring DES.
